parameters.content:
## Data Anomaly Detector with AI

Runs on a schedule to read metrics from Google Sheets, performs statistical analysis (z-score), and if anomalies are detected, uses OpenAI to explain them and sends a Telegram alert.

**Setup:**
1. Configure Google Sheets with numeric metric columns
2. Add OpenAI API key and Telegram bot credentials
3. Adjust schedule interval and z-score threshold (default: 2.5)
